title: aspidium mascarenense
intro: Aspidium mascarenense, commonly known as the Mascarene fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Blechnaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to offer various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium mascarenense include acting as a demulcent, soothing mucous membranes and providing relief from coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
